name: Infinity Achilles

ability.name: Infinity Attack
ability.description: Attack Mode. The Infinity Ring charges every 2 turns, amplifying damage by 30% per charge. Switching into this form converts 50% of the shed Defense into Attack.

abilities.name: Infinity Attack
abilities.description: Attack Mode. The Infinity Ring charges every 2 turns, amplifying damage by 30% per charge. Switching into this form converts 50% of the shed Defense into Attack.

abilities.name: Infinity Defense
abilities.description: Defense Mode. The free-spinning ring bleeds off impact — incoming damage reduced by 15 and 30% of what lands is absorbed rather than taken.

special_move.name: Infinite Attack
special_move.charged_flavour_text: ⚔️✨ **Infinite Attack — RING FULLY CHARGED** — Infinity Achilles UNLEASHES THE ULTIMATE STRIKE — **{dmg} DAMAGE**!
special_move.description: The ring releases everything it has stored into one unstoppable strike.
flavour_texts: ⚔️ **Infinite Attack** — the ring unwinds in one blow!

special_move_2.name: Infinite Shield
special_move_2.description: Achilles plants the ring and turns the stadium's fury back on its owner.
flavour_texts: 🛡️ **Infinite Shield** — every blow returns to sender!

description: The infinite ring never stops turning. Achilles locks into Attack or Defense form before launch and rides that choice to the end — one charges a strike that grows every turn, the other turns the enemy's own force back on them.
